g.text: no door: a 2 m gap, a 3 m opening

edge. 2 — accounting has no door; its screen stops 2 m short and a 3 m cased opening does the
rest. 3 — the Annex is 46.75 m². 4 — five `zone` blocks group every room, and their subtotals
partition the total exactly: 87.00 + 240.00 + 48.00 + 118.25 + 46.75 = 540.00. 5 — the back
